title: docs(khostty/phase-b-gtk): wire-up specification
body:
Phase B of the khostty mux project (GTK-on-Linux runtime wire-up) is now specified. The IPC substrate (Phase A) is built and unit-tested; this PR is docs only, specifying the GTK glue so Phase B can be executed the moment a Linux GTK host is reachable and Q1 (publishability) is decided.

Single new doc: docs/sessions/20261017-mux-design/05_PHASE_B_GTK_WIREUP.md (1,412 lines) — covers B1 (Server.bind), B2 (pane.write hop), B4 (4 event publishes), B5 (2 snapshot counters), E2E (6-test acceptance script), rollback, and R1-R12 risks.

Why docs only: fork (KooshaPari/khostty), not upstream ghostty-org/ghostty. Phase A is the proven base. Spec-first means a 30-min audit vs ~200 lines of zig.

Fork-only per the 2026-10-15 operator rule. No PRs/issues/discussions against ghostty-org/ghostty.

tx-validated: manual (no cargo/zig run, this is a doc).
